scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks/Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees (GLWB)
description:
The Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks and Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers and Employees is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched in the year 2007. 

It was introduced to provide financial assistance to the children of industrial workers. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to alleviate the financial burden on families of industrial workers. 

The scheme aims to ensure that children have access to necessary educational materials. 

This includes textbooks and notebooks which are essential for their studies. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to promote education among children of workers. 

The government recognizes the importance of education in improving the socio-economic status of families. 

The scheme specifically targets children studying in classes 1 to 12. 

Eligible beneficiaries can receive a grant of ₹1,000 per child per academic year. 

This amount is intended to cover the costs of textbooks and notebooks. 

The assistance is provided directly to the beneficiaries' bank accounts. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

The Labour Welfare Board is responsible for the execution of this scheme. 

To be eligible for this scheme, applicants must meet specific criteria. 

The applicant must be a child of an industrial worker or employee. 

The worker must be registered with the relevant Labour Welfare Board. 

The family income of the worker should not exceed ₹15,000 per month. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the assistance reaches those in genuine need. 

The applicant must be studying in a recognized school. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required for the parents. 

The application process is straightforward and involves several steps. 

Applicants must fill out the prescribed application form. 

The form can be obtained from the Labour Welfare Board office or downloaded online. 

Along with the application form, certain documents are required. 

These documents include proof of identity of the applicant. 

Proof of the worker's registration with the Labour Welfare Board is also needed. 

Additionally, income proof must be submitted. 

This can be in the form of a salary slip or an income certificate. 

Proof of the child's enrollment in school is also mandatory. 

Once the application is completed with all necessary documents, it should be submitted to the local Labour Welfare Board office. 

The application will then be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Upon approval, the financial assistance will be disbursed. 

The disbursement is typically made in one installment at the beginning of the academic year. 

The scheme is reviewed periodically to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also taken into account for improvements. 

The financial assistance is expected to help reduce dropout rates among children of industrial workers. 

It aims to encourage parents to send their children to school. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to promoting education. 

It also aims to enhance the overall welfare of industrial workers and their families. 

As of 2023, the scheme continues to be operational. 

It has positively impacted thousands of families across India. 

The government has allocated a specific budget for this scheme each year. 

In the financial year 2022-2023, ₹100 crores was allocated for the scheme. 

This allocation is aimed at reaching a larger number of beneficiaries. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the living standards of industrial workers. 

It complements other welfare measures aimed at the same demographic. 

The Labour Welfare Board conducts awareness programs to inform workers about the scheme. 

These programs are essential for ensuring that eligible families are aware of the assistance available. 

The scheme has been instrumental in promoting literacy among children of industrial workers. 

It has also contributed to the overall development of the workforce in India. 

The government encourages feedback from beneficiaries to improve the scheme. 

This feedback mechanism helps in making necessary adjustments to the scheme. 

The scheme is an important step towards achieving educational equity. 

It aims to bridge the gap between different socio-economic classes in education. 

The financial assistance is a crucial support for low-income families. 

It helps in providing the necessary resources for children's education. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public. 

Many families have expressed gratitude for the financial support. 

The government continues to monitor the effectiveness of the scheme. 

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the objectives are being met. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of social security measures in India. 

It aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations. 

The focus on education is a key component of these goals. 

The scheme is expected to continue evolving to meet the changing needs of industrial workers. 

The government remains committed to enhancing educational opportunities for all children. 

The Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks and Notebooks is a vital initiative. 

It plays a crucial role in supporting the education of children from economically weaker sections. 

This scheme exemplifies the government's dedication to improving the lives of industrial workers and their families. 

Through this initiative, the government aims to foster a more educated and skilled workforce in India.
